Codex review: needs changes before merge. ## What this changes This PR moves shared Control UI overlays and tabs to native browser surfaces and Solid while preserving existing interactions. **Example:** Open the New group dialog. - **Before:** A Web Awesome dialog displays the focused name field and Create group and Cancel buttons. - **After:** A native dialog displays the same field, buttons, and appearance through the Solid implementation. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦪 silver shellfish **(2/6)** | Strong visual evidence and successful broad validation support the migration, but the confirmed recovery defect still blocks merge. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** ✨ media proof bonus | Sufficient (screenshot): Inspected browser captures show the migrated modal, panel tabs, and mobile rich tooltip retaining their appearance; exact-head full CI separately supports keyboard, lifecycle, and consumer coverage. | | **Patch quality** | 🦪 silver shellfish **(2/6)** | 1 actionable review finding remain. | ## Product **Kind:** Refactor · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Existing keyboard navigation, focus, cancellation, and appearance must survive the Control UI's Solid migration. **Reason:** The recorded owner direction supports replacing renderer-specific primitives with shared native owners while preserving caller contracts. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Needs changes before merge - 1 item remains** Keep this maintainer-directed migration open; the previously reported placement-dialog recovery defect remains a merge blocker. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `8d0329c1e7e00163f571b49951db3d92ad9699a8` ## Before merge - [ ] **Reset placement-dialog reentrancy when modal loading rejects (P2)** - If the first modal-dialog import rejects before registration, this failure path rejects without calling the placement caller's finish callback. showSessionPlacementTargetDialog sets its module-level active flag before calling the helper and clears it only inside finish, so every subsequent move, dispatch, or restart attempt silently resolves null until reload. This previously reported finding remains unchanged at the reviewed head. Clear the caller-owned flag in finally while preserving rejection, and cover failed loading followed by another attempt. ## Findings - [P2] Reset placement-dialog reentrancy when modal loading rejects — `ui/src/components/promise-modal-host.ts:63-69` ### Tests - Missing end-to-end proof: Existing loading coverage does not exercise a rejected first modal import followed by a successful second placement-dialog attempt.
Agent review details ### How this fits together Control UI callers pass content and presentation state into shared overlay and tab owners, which manage browser surfaces, keyboard interaction, focus, and native-view occlusion. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Control UI callers] --> B[Registered component bridges] B --> C[Solid views] C --> D[Shared overlay lifecycle] C --> E[Shared tab controller] D --> F[Native browser surfaces] D --> G[Focus and native occlusion] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Retain the shared native migration and release placement-dialog reentrancy on every promise settlement, including loading failure. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Pinned-head source establishes the rejected-import-to-latched-active path; no target code or tests were executed during this read-only review. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The shared native owners follow the recorded migration direction; fixing cleanup in the placement caller preserves that ownership without expanding the modal-host API. Full review comments: - [P2] Reset placement-dialog reentrancy when modal loading rejects — `ui/src/components/promise-modal-host.ts:63-69` If the first modal-dialog import rejects before registration, this failure path rejects without calling the placement caller's finish callback. showSessionPlacementTargetDialog sets its module-level active flag before calling the helper and clears it only inside finish, so every subsequent move, dispatch, or restart attempt silently resolves null until reload. This previously reported finding remains unchanged at the reviewed head. Clear the caller-owned flag in finally while preserving rejection, and cover failed loading followed by another attempt. Confidence: 0.99 Overall correctness: patch is incorrect Overall confidence: 0.97 AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. ([`ui/src/components/session-placement-move-dialog.tsx:59`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/8d0329c1e7e00163f571b49951db3d92ad9699a8/ui/src/components/session-placement-move-dialog.tsx#L59), [8d0329c1e7e0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8d0329c1e7e00163f571b49951db3d92ad9699a8)) - **Current main still uses the previous renderer:** Fetched main retains the Web Awesome modal implementation and tab groups, so the central migration is still distinct work.
